name: Range day at Kapustin Yar: a target at the far edge of the zone
description: A live-fire range shoot in the style of Kapustin Yar on the lower Volga (roadmap 10.1): a slow target drone at medium height comes in on a course that passes 5 km to the side, so it enters the zone at its far edge, 10 km out. The task is to launch as early as the zone allows: the crew that is ready when ЦЕЛЬ В ЗОНЕ lights gets its missile away near the edge. The NPC commander runs the crew; take any seat, or his.
notes: The range follows docs/research/OSA_RESEARCH_2026-10.md section 9 (samsim_thread, ilya_prosto, korovin_tiv_2010); docs/SOURCES.md's validation list has a kill near the maximum range, 10.3 km, at Kapustin Yar in 2013. That was in Russian service (an Osa-AKM, whose preparation starts at ВНИМАНИЕ); SAM3D's Osa-AK starts it when the target is in the zone (flak11, NVA), so here the missile goes about 15 s after the lamp, a little inside the edge. PLACEHOLDERS: the drone's speed, height, course and echo.

terrain.notes: The steppe of the lower Volga: flat.
